bio: Platform administrator and executive coach with over a decade of experience in leadership development, organisational transformation, and peer coaching facilitation. Passionate about building communities that foster authentic growth.

Certified peer coach specialising in career transitions, mindfulness-based leadership, and personal effectiveness. Committed to creating a safe space for reflective conversations and meaningful breakthroughs.
Aspiring coach with a background in organisational psychology and human-centred design. Eager to contribute to peer coaching communities and support others on their professional journeys.
